description: The services to be furnished under this contract include consolidated facility management services for the Andover Service Center (ASC) NY. The contractor shall provide services for facility management, operation, preventive maintenance, pest control, custodial, snow removal, repair services for buildings, structures, grounds, utilities and related support systems and equipment at U.S. Department of Treasury, Internal Revenue Service (IRS), Andover Service Center (ASC), 310 Lowell St, Andover, MA 01810.
